ranking.name: Rain and snow (precipitation)
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, rain and snow (precipitation) in Mexico shows no statistically significant trend (p = 0.70): the estimate is +0.02 mm/day per decade (95% confidence interval −0.09 to +0.13). This does not mean nothing changed; the data cannot tell a trend this small apart from natural ups and downs.

ranking.name: Water leaving the land (evapotranspiration)
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, water leaving the land (evapotranspiration) in Mexico shows no statistically significant trend (p = 0.78): the estimate is −0.010 mm/day per decade (95% confidence interval −0.078 to +0.061). This does not mean nothing changed; the data cannot tell a trend this small apart from natural ups and downs.
